title: Liquidated Damages on Noticed Early Terminations - Commercial and Industrial Electricity Contracts
content:
## Liquidated damages on a noticed early termination (Commercial and Industrial Electricity Contracts)

Liquidated damages on a noticed early termination are billed on a contract whose authorized signatory gave written notice to end it during its term and which is in termination pending status, as one early termination fee line per contract.

## Billing the damages: `bill_noticed_termination_damages_6fb56a64`

The agent unlocks `bill_noticed_termination_damages_6fb56a64` and then calls it.

**Capability.** One call adds one early termination fee line to the contract's bill, dated today, carrying the dollar amount and the remaining contracted kWh passed. The net charges billed on the contract rise by that amount, and the line then appears among the contract's bill lines. The contract's status and dates are not changed.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `cni_contract_id` | the commercial and industrial contract number of the terminating contract, as shown on the contract record returned by the contract lookup | contract number |
| `amount_usd` | the damages billed | US dollars, a positive number rounded half up to 2 decimal places; stored exactly as passed |
| `etf_remaining_kwh` | the remaining contracted kWh the damages were measured on | a whole number of kWh, no decimals |

**Return.** A confirmation carrying `cni_billing_id` (the reference number of the new bill line), `cni_contract_id` (the contract billed), `line_type`, always `early_termination_fee`, `amount_usd` (2 decimal places), `etf_remaining_kwh` (a whole number) and `posted_date` (today, YYYY-MM-DD). A returned `cni_billing_id` means the line is on the contract's bill.

## Questions on scope

- *How many lines does one noticed termination produce?* One early termination fee line per contract.
- *Which contracts are in scope?* A contract in termination pending status whose authorized signatory gave written notice during the term to end it.
